title: Ginsenoside Rh2 inhibits epithelial-mesenchymal transition in triple-negative breast cancer cell via disrupting the HIF-1alpha/YAP nuclear translocation axis.
authors: Liu, Huijuan; Ye, Hui; Han, Guohui
one_liner_zh: 研究人参皂苷Rh2通过HIF-1alpha/YAP核转位轴抑制三阴性乳腺癌EMT，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作核心，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Ginsenoside Rh2 (G-Rh2) is a primary bioactive constituent of ginseng (Panax ginseng C.A. Meyer), has been demonstrated to possess anti-tumor potential. However, its specific inhibitory effects on triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) and the associated molecular mechanisms have not been fully elucidated. The hypoxic microenvironment is a key factor driving TNBC malignancy and dissemination, often leading to enhanced tumor invasiveness and increased metastatic risk. This study aimed to evaluate the inhibitory effects of G-Rh2 on TNBC cells and tumor growth and to identify the key molecular mechanisms responsible. This study integrated multiple experimental techniques, including western blot, immunofluorescence, histopathological staining, co-immunoprecipitation, cellular thermal shift assay, cell scratch assay, and molecular docking. Additionally, network pharmacology, hypoxia inducible factor 1alpha (HIF-1alpha) overexpression validation, and HIF-1alpha small interfering RNA (si-RNA)-mediated knockdown were combined to systematically dissect its key regulatory pathways. G-Rh2 was shown to suppress the growth of breast tumors in mice and concurrently induce apoptosis in TNBC cells. The underlying mechanisms involved downregulation of HIF-1alpha expression, activation of the Hippo pathway to suppress cell migration and invasion, and intervention in the HIF-1alpha/YAP nuclear translocation axis, thereby inhibiting epithelial mesenchymal transition (EMT). This study systematically revealed the inhibitory effect of G-Rh2 on TNBC through in vivo and in vitro models, providing new mechanistic evidence and theoretical support for natural product-based antitumor research.
abstract_zh: 人参皂苷Rh2（G-Rh2）是人参（Panax ginseng C.A. Meyer）的主要生物活性成分，已被证明具有抗肿瘤潜力。然而，其对三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）的特异性抑制作用及相关分子机制尚未完全阐明。缺氧微环境是驱动TNBC恶性进展和播散的关键因素，常导致肿瘤侵袭性增强和转移风险增加。本研究旨在评估G-Rh2对TNBC细胞和肿瘤生长的抑制作用，并确定其关键分子机制。本研究整合了多种实验技术，包括蛋白质印迹、免疫荧光、组织病理学染色、免疫共沉淀、细胞热位移分析、细胞划痕实验和分子对接。此外，结合网络药理学、缺氧诱导因子1α（HIF-1α）过表达验证及HIF-1α小干扰RNA（si-RNA）介导的敲低，系统剖析其关键调控通路。结果表明，G-Rh2可抑制小鼠乳腺肿瘤生长，并同时诱导TNBC细胞凋亡。其潜在机制涉及下调HIF-1α表达、激活Hippo通路以抑制细胞迁移和侵袭，以及干预HIF-1α/YAP核转位轴，从而抑制上皮间质转化（EMT）。本研究通过体内和体外模型系统揭示了G-Rh2对TNBC的抑制作用，为基于天然产物的抗肿瘤研究提供了新的机制证据和理论支持。
